source.listed: taxonomy-index.json: products placed in each node and its narrower ones; researched = facts from its own pages
source.announcements: events.json, observed: the vendor's own feed, changelog or GitHub releases (release, changelog, blog), read 2026-11-05, the latest 3 of each kind per product in 30 days
source.conversation: events.json, observed: Hacker News stories linking to the product's own site, same window and cap
source.watched: products whose own channels AirStack reads: the researched catalog and the registry-tracked tools. A listed product outside them has no announcement record: unknown, not zero
source.inception: Wikidata P571 (CC0), read 2026-11-03; dated = products with an inception year
source.rule: a node's rate is compared with its parent's (a sector's with all sectors); shown when its base is at least 20, the larger of its count and its expected count is at least 5, and it differs by at least 10 points and 1.5x
